extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: A benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation, containing 1,825 diverse tasks across nine domains stratified by complexity.
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.citeAs: Chenchen Zhang, Yuhang Li, et al. ArtifactsBench: Bridging the Visual-Interactive Gap in LLM Code Generation Evaluation. arXiv:2507.04952, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Curated 1,825 diverse tasks via a multi-stage pipeline combining expert sourcing with LLM generation and refinement.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Automated filters dropped incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items. Two-stage filtering using MinHash + semantic similarity and screenshot perceptual hashing. Flagged items were re-authored or discarded.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Experts rewrote prompts for clarity/completeness/executability; LLM rewriting added diverse styles; humans verified. Solvability validation and ambiguity repair were performed, pruning underspecified items or those solved only by brittle hacks.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each query is paired with a 10-dimension checklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities. Checklists were LLM-drafted (Hunyuan-Turbos) and then human-refined for specificity and screenability.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A 10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achieves Cohen’s κ≥0.8 among annotators; the seed is reused as few-shot references to keep difficulty high and rubrics consistent.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Engineers with extensive front-end development experience
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Open-sourced dataset specs, checklist templates, evaluation scripts, and referee settings.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None (filtered out to avoid requesting or involving sensitive personal information)
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Discrete sampling of screenshots may not fully capture the fluidity, correctness, and robustness of highly complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions. Does not assess agentic or iterative development capabilities.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifacts, Testing
